component.name: Saga Scribe
component.summary: TEI-XML manuscript transcription editor with custom DSL shorthand

description.p: Saga Scribe is a desktop application for manuscript transcription that uses a custom domain-specific language (DSL) to generate TEI-XML output with MENOTA support.

ul.li: Custom DSL for efficient transcription with syntax highlighting
Real-time preview with XSLT rendering
TEI-XML export with MENOTA compatibility
XML validation against TEI P5, MENOTA, and MENOTA P5 schemas
ONP (Dictionary of Old Norse Prose) integration for lemmatization
MUFI character support with Junicode font
Import existing TEI-XML documents
Export to HTML and PDF formats
Word and character-level annotations

description.p: Lemmas that stay on their words, lemmas written into imported files, and smooth typing in large manuscripts.

ul.li: Lemmas and annotations follow their words when words are inserted or deleted
Confirmed lemmas are written into imported TEI files; lemmas from the file leave it unchanged
Normalized forms can be set without a lemma, and lemmas can be edited or removed
Typing stays responsive in large manuscripts; previews update after a pause in typing
Editor highlighting matches the compiler exactly
The window shows the theme and a loading indicator while the app starts

description.p: Faster XSLT preview: after an edit, only the changed pages are rendered again.
Safer round-trip editing of imported files, paragraphs, and typeset PDFs.

ul.li: Imported files are written back byte for byte; only what you edit changes
Editing an imported word keeps its lemma, analysis and normalized form, and marks it for review
Paragraphs can be split and joined with .p
Mid-word line breaks (~//) are kept in the XML and shown in the preview
PDF export with page margins and page numbers, saved straight to a file
Faster previews: only the edited part of the text is re-rendered
Syntax errors are underlined where they occur

description.p: Current development release with full feature set.
